# Book.Deals.India

> Online book store in India selling discounted bestseller combos and books. Pay online via UPI and confirm the order on WhatsApp.

Website: https://book-deals-india.github.io/
WhatsApp for orders and queries: +91 92510 73424

## Books

- The Metamorphosis + My Inventions (Combo of 2 Books): Franz Kafka's classic The Metamorphosis with Nikola Tesla's autobiography My Inventions. Price: Rs 239, online payment.
- Why I Am an Atheist and Other Works, Bhagat Singh: Essays by Shaheed Bhagat Singh including "Why I Am an Atheist". Price: Rs 149, online payment.

## How to order

1. Select a book and click "Order Now".
2. Enter name, mobile number and full delivery address, and send the order on WhatsApp.
3. Pay via UPI and share the payment screenshot on WhatsApp. The order is processed after confirmation.

## Returns and refunds

- Damaged, torn or incorrect books: share a photo or unboxing video on WhatsApp within 48 hours of delivery. After verification we send a free replacement or a full refund.
- Returns or exchanges are not accepted for change of mind or personal preference.
- To cancel an order, message us on WhatsApp before dispatch.

## Delivery

- Delivery across India. Delivery charges and timing are confirmed on WhatsApp.
